title: Ofsted success for Fledgling Explorers nursery, Harvington
body: Fledgling Explorers nursery has been inspected under Ofsted's new framework, and achieved Strong Standards in Children's Welfare and Well-being and in Behaviour, Attitudes and Establishing Routines, and Expected Standards in the four other areas. The report highlights the nursery's warm, nurturing and well-organised environment, how well the staff know each child, and how quickly children form secure attachments.
